hubTitle: Thailand attractions | Temples, markets and museums | ThaiLiveNow
hubDescription: Find temples, rooftops, zoos, aquariums, markets, museums, historic sites and water parks in Thailand. Explore the sights, addresses, opening hours, admission fees and travel information.

categories.name: Temples
categories.text: See gilded stupas, halls with murals and ancient temples reduced to brick ruins. Choose between active places of worship and archaeological sites.

categories.name: Rooftops and observation decks
categories.text: For views from above, choose between observation facilities and rooftops serving food and drinks. Ticket and reservation conditions differ.

categories.name: Zoos and aquariums
categories.text: Explore spacious zoos or aquarium exhibits and underwater tunnels. With children, consider how you will move around and which extra activities you want.

categories.name: Night markets and markets
categories.text: Browse food and crafts at night markets or visit floating markets beside canals. Weekend markets and daily markets need different plans.

categories.name: Museums and historic sites
categories.text: See art in former homes or walk through old royal capitals and temple ruins. Indoor museums and historical parks spread across several sites offer different visits.

categories.name: Theme parks and water parks
categories.text: Spend a day on rides or in the water. A child ticket does not override individual ride height limits and accompanying-adult requirements.

categories.name: Streets and neighbourhoods
categories.text: Explore old shopping streets and lanes, stopping for cafés, food and architecture. Daytime neighbourhood walks and streets with evening markets have different atmospheres.
